name: riqor
description: Evidence gates, session continuity, managed Codex workflows, and release checks for AI coding agents

interface.shortDescription: Evidence gates and continuity for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Adds repository-scoped evidence gates, managed Codex session continuity, diagnostics, release checks, and bounded lifecycle guidance. The local npm runtime is installed or upgraded explicitly from a terminal; the plugin never publishes packages or replaces the Codex binary.
defaultPrompt: Set up Riqor for this repository and verify it.
Run this task with Riqor evidence gates.
Diagnose this Riqor or managed Codex failure.
